parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const id=String($('Prepare Conversation').first().json.property_id||''); const r=rows.find(x=>String(x.property_id||'')===id); if(!r) throw new Error('Property not found: '+id); return [{json:{...$('Prepare Conversation').first().json,...r,phone:$('Prepare Conversation').first().json.phone,phone_number_id:$('Prepare Conversation').first().json.phone_number_id}}];

const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const base=$('Prepare Conversation').first().json; const r=rows.find(x=>String(x.property_id||'')===String(base.property_id||'')); if(!r) throw new Error('Viewing property not found'); return [{json:{...base,...r,phone:base.phone,phone_number_id:base.phone_number_id,viewing_requested:true}}];

const input=$('Viewing - Select Property').first().json; const events=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const now=new Date(); const slots=[]; function busy(s,e){return events.some(ev=>{const es=new Date(ev.start?.dateTime||ev.start?.date||0), ee=new Date(ev.end?.dateTime||ev.end?.date||0); return s<ee && e>es;});} for(let d=1;d<=7 && slots.length<5;d++){ for(const h of [10,12,14,16,18]){const s=new Date(now); s.setDate(now.getDate()+d); s.setHours(h,0,0,0); const e=new Date(s); e.setMinutes(30); if(!busy(s,e)) slots.push({start:s.toISOString(),end:e.toISOString(),label:s.toLocaleString('en-GB',{weekday:'short',day:'2-digit',month:'short',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}); if(slots.length>=5) break;} } const data=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); if(!data.pendingViewing) data.pendingViewing={}; data.pendingViewing[input.phone]={property:{...input},property_id:input.property_id,agent_calendar_email:input.agent_calendar_email||input.agent_email,slots,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}; return [{json:{...input,available_slots:slots}}];

parameters.jsCode: const j=$input.first().json; const lead={...(j.lead||{})}; let score=Number(lead.leadScore||0); const action=String(j.property_action||''); if(action==='viewing'||j.viewing_requested) score=Math.min(100,score+15); if(lead.budget&&lead.timeline) score=Math.min(100,score+5); if(lead.intent&&lead.propertyType) score=Math.min(100,score+3); lead.leadScore=score; lead.temperature=score>=80?'hot':score>=45?'warm':'cold'; lead.lastInteraction=new Date().toISOString(); if(score>=80) lead.status='hot'; const data=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); data.leads[j.phone]={...(data.leads?.[j.phone]||{}),...lead}; return [{json:{...j,lead,lead_score:score,temperature:lead.temperature}}];

const data=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const leads=Object.values(data.leads||{}); const now=Date.now(); const out=[]; for(const l of leads){if(l.aiPaused||l.status==='human_requested') continue; const last=new Date(l.lastUpdated||0).getTime(); const ageH=(now-last)/3600000; if(ageH>=24 && ageH<48 && !l.followup24Sent) out.push({...l,followupType:'24h'}); else if(ageH>=48 && !l.followup48Sent) out.push({...l,followupType:'48h'});} return out.map(x=>({json:x}));

const data=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const j=$input.first().json; const lead={...(data.leads?.[j.phone]||j.lead||{})}; lead.status='human_requested'; lead.humanRequested=true; lead.aiPaused=true; lead.handoffAt=new Date().toISOString(); data.leads[j.phone]=lead; const q=Array.isArray(data.handoffQueue)?data.handoffQueue:[]; if(!q.some(x=>x.phone===j.phone)) q.push({phone:j.phone,name:lead.name,score:lead.leadScore,temperature:lead.temperature,property_id:j.property_id||'',at:lead.handoffAt}); data.handoffQueue=q.slice(-500); return [{json:{...j,lead,handoff_queue_size:data.handoffQueue.length}}];

parameters.content:
## PHASE 4 - Configure media URLs

Add public HTTPS photo/video/floor-plan/brochure URLs to Google Sheets. Test each media node.

## PHASE 5 - Google Calendar

Select your Google Calendar OAuth credential on both calendar nodes. agent_calendar_email must contain the calendar email/ID.

## PHASE 5 - Booking selection

The current build sends real free slots. The next execution step should store slots per phone and route the customer numeric selection back to Create Calendar Event.

## PHASE 6 - Follow-ups

Schedule Trigger runs every 6 hours and checks workflow staticData. For production scale, move lead state to a database.

## PHASE 7 - Human takeover

Human handoff sets aiPaused=true and records the lead in the in-workflow handoff queue. Connect this queue to your CRM/Slack/email in the execution step.

## CREDENTIALS

After import, select your working WhatsApp Cloud API credential/header, Gemini credential, Google Sheets credential, and Google Calendar OAuth credential. Never paste real access tokens into the workflow JSON.
